description: Inputs an external caller passes to run the kernel unit tests: the packaged controller, the options every leaf shares, and each leaf's custom-case parameters with runnable examples. unit_test/README.md "External invocation" explains the fields; common/ut_interface.py turns parameter values into commands and runs them; common/test_ut_interface.py checks this file against kernel_ut_main.cpp, the leaf Makefiles and the leaf sources.

commands.list: every leaf with its custom parameters
commands.show <leaf>: parameter table, constraints and examples of one leaf
commands.command <leaf> [name=value ...]: the controller and make commands for those parameter values
commands.run <leaf> --bin <bin> [name=value ...]: run that case through the controller and print its results.csv rows
commands.verify --bin <bin>: run every example below through the controller and report PASS/FAIL

args.description: Run only this leaf (<op>/<leaf>, the `leaf` field below). Gets the same DLL search path, environment, stderr capture and results.csv as the suite.
Selects bin/kernel-tests/<arch>/ with the EP's DLL rule: the ISA's own directory first, then its generic target's (gfx115x -> gfx11-generic).
lookup resolves configs from the tables embedded in custom_kernels_<arch>.dll and falls through to autotune on a miss; autotune bypasses the tables.
Shape-coverage tier passed to every leaf as --coverage <N>.
Timing preset passed to every leaf through HIPDNN_UT_TIMING. confirm is the formal measurement.
With --leaf: every following argument goes to the leaf unchanged instead of --coverage <N>. Build them from the leaf's custom.params (common/ut_interface.py command does).

controller.leaf_command: <bin>/kernel-tests/<arch>/<package_executable> --coverage <N>, or the arguments after -- when --leaf is given

exit_codes.1: At least one leaf failed or could not be launched.
exit_codes.2: Bad argument, no GPU detected, or no packaged tests for that arch.

outputs: bin/out/results.csv (one row per case and one shape=suite row per leaf)
bin/out/<executable stem>.stderr.log for a failed leaf

make.description: Build target. gfx11-generic covers gfx115x; pass --offload-arch=gfx1170 or --offload-arch=gfx1171 for those chips. gfx1151 is the default validation chip.

make.default: GPU of the build machine (amdgpu-arch) for a generic target
make.description: Chip whose table a MODE=lookup build embeds.
lookup links the real resolver and table and sets the kernel's own HIPDNN_<OP>_AUTOTUNE_MODE=lookup; autotune never reads a table. Ops without a table only label results.csv.
RANK=1 builds the UT ranking variant (ops with an offline LUT); it forces MODE=autotune.
flatc used by a MODE=lookup build.
flatbuffers include directory for a MODE=lookup build.
Optional ADLX SDK include directory; enables GPU-clock telemetry in UT_TIMING.

params.name: batch
params.description: Positive request count.

params.name: num_heads
params.description: Positive query heads, multiple of kv_num_heads.

params.name: kv_num_heads
params.description: Positive KV heads.

params.name: head_dim
params.description: 64/96/128/256; unsupported geometry can be tested with error=geometry.

params.name: num_pages
params.description: Positive physical pool page count; shared readonly prefixes may reduce required count.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Positive token slots per page, independent of computation tile.

params.name: table_columns
params.description: Positive per-request page table width; must hold ceil(post/S).

params.name: q_lens
params.description: Comma-separated B nonnegative int32 lengths; decode each is 0/1. T=sum(q_lens) fits int32.

params.name: past
params.description: Comma-separated B nonnegative int32 history lengths; post must fit int32 and mapping capacity.

params.name: do_rotary
params.description: 0 disables rotary and 1 enables full-D split-half rotary.

params.name: rotary_dim
params.description: 0 expands to D in this driver; public entry requires D when enabled. Other values are unsupported.

params.name: interleaved
params.description: 0 is split-half; 1 is unsupported when rotary is enabled.

params.name: max_position
params.description: Positive cos/sin row capacity; active rotary positions must be below it.

params.name: scale
params.description: 0 selects 1/sqrt(D), finite positive values are explicit; negative is unsupported, nonfinite invalid.

params.name: window
params.description: Nonpositive is full causal history. Positive W includes current token; prefill D256 rejects it.

params.name: softcap
params.description: Only zero is supported; nonzero declines.

params.name: mapping
params.description: ordered/permuted/shared; shared requires a readonly first prefix page, append pages remain private.

params.name: seed
params.description: Input and page-permutation seed in uint32 range.

params.name: error
params.description: Inject only into a valid base. Host validator rejects inapplicable triggers before allocation/reference; write_conflict requires two active requests. Exact host/device rejection and unchanged storage are checked.

params.name: phase
params.description: Must match the selected leaf.

params.name: shared_prefix
params.description: MAP=shared: 0 uses one readonly page; positive token count must be divisible by S and <=past of active requests.

constraints: All geometry values except T are positive int32. All tensor/launch products are checked for overflow.
q_lens and past have B nonnegative items. Caller must provision P/M for the chosen mapping.
Rotary is full-D split-half. Shared map requires past>=S for active requests.
error chooses explicit expected rejection tests; malformed or unsupported ordinary custom cases fail.
write_conflict requires at least two q>0 requests; picks stable pair, lowers larger past and aliases append-start page. B2 with two active requests is supported.

cum_start/cum_end/cum_order/negative_past/decode_length/post_overflow/table_small/bad_page/position/write_conflict/workspace/workspace_alignment/alias/pool_alias/tensor_alignment/null_rotary require T>0.

decode_length requires T>=2 and supported decode head geometry. table_small requires M*S<2147483647. position requires at least one active post>1. position/null_rotary normalize full-D split-half RoPE.
d256_window is prefill-only. Host descriptor rejection cases may use T=0; ordinary all-empty cases remain valid.
checks: batch > 0 and num_heads > 0 and kv_num_heads > 0 and num_heads % kv_num_heads == 0
num_pages > 0 and page_size > 0 and table_columns > 0 and max_position > 0
shared_prefix >= 0 and (shared_prefix == 0 or mapping == 'shared' and shared_prefix % page_size == 0)

diagnostic_flags.description: 0|1, requires COMPARE=1 and FLASH_SOURCE build. Same logical FP16 data compares complete Page/dense, original bare Flash and common post-RoPE cores with shared timer. Diagnostic Page fallback is explicitly default; normal MODE still uses online fallback.
0: Page complete first (default); 1: dense complete first. Alternate across same-host pairs; same data/config/copies and confirm preset.
0|1; list actual coverage/custom keys without GPU allocation or launches. All tiers retain supported RoPE x window combinations.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_AUTOTUNE_MODE
env.description: lookup reads a compatible Page table; online explicitly uses production preparePagedAttention/GQA tuning before final complete-call validation/timing.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_CFG
env.description: Optional default, id=N, legacy splits=N;bkv=N or six-field splits/bkv/hb/qw/mt/nd pin. V2 decode splits=0 is adaptive. Actual fixed:pin geometry logged; forbidden with ranking.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_RANK
env.description: Four-column leaf,shape,priority,config CSV; requires RANK=1 and default per shape. Exact native case key preserves ragged arrays/page/RoPE/options.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_RANK_CATALOG
env.description: 1 emits production Page candidate catalog without GPU work; requires HIPDNN_UT_RANK and RANK=1.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_RANK_REFERENCE
env.description: 1 uses independent sequential confirm in existing shared rank engine.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_PUBLIC
env.description: 1 validates and times the actual public/default entry; config readback stays outside timing; conflicts with production preparation.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_PRODUCTION_PREPARE
env.description: 1 in comparison calls the real production lookup/online preparation before configured timing; conflicts with public/pinned route.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_FLASH_CFG
env.description: Six-field original Flash configured geometry for marked same-geometry diagnostic comparison.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_FLASH_NATIVE_CFG
env.description: Original Flash native pin: wmma plus splits/bkv/hb/qw/mt/nd; optional pipe-separated active-request list. Must match original legal candidates; conflicts with old diagnostic pin.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_COMPARE_RANK
env.description: page|flash ranks that complete comparison entry through the shared native engine, with CPU/storage checks and finite production candidates; Page requires RANK=1. Conflicts with public/preparation/config pins.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_COMPARE_COMPLETE_ONLY
env.description: 1 skips bare/core timing in COMPARE=1 while retaining both complete timings and precision/storage checks. Unmeasured diagnostics are null.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_DENSE_CAPACITY
env.description: Comparison-only positive dense storage capacity, applied symmetrically to old/new controls for capacity sentinels; no production dispatch change.

build_inputs.RANK: 0|1; 1 compiles UT-only adapter and private empty table
build_inputs.LUT_ARCH: actual device chip for default table path
build_inputs.LUT_FB: external Page FB compiled from JSON, embedded at build; explicit missing path fails; absent default table uses online fallback
build_inputs.FLASH_SOURCE: exact original source with baseline/hash; compiled through symbol isolation adapter

params.description: 0 expands to D in this driver; public entry requires D when enabled. Other values are unsupported.

params.name: interleaved
params.description: 0 is split-half; 1 is unsupported when rotary is enabled.

params.name: max_position
params.description: Positive cos/sin row capacity; active rotary positions must be below it.

params.name: scale
params.description: 0 selects 1/sqrt(D), finite positive values are explicit; negative is unsupported, nonfinite invalid.

params.name: window
params.description: Nonpositive is full causal history. Positive W includes current token; prefill D256 rejects it.

params.name: softcap
params.description: Only zero is supported; nonzero declines.

params.name: mapping
params.description: ordered/permuted/shared; shared requires a readonly first prefix page, append pages remain private.

params.name: seed
params.description: Input and page-permutation seed in uint32 range.

params.name: error
params.description: Inject only into a valid base. Host validator rejects inapplicable triggers before allocation/reference; write_conflict requires two active requests. Exact host/device rejection and unchanged storage are checked.

params.name: phase
params.description: Must match the selected leaf.

params.name: shared_prefix
params.description: MAP=shared: 0 uses one readonly page; positive token count must be divisible by S and <=past of active requests.

constraints: All geometry values except T are positive int32. All tensor/launch products are checked for overflow.
q_lens and past have B nonnegative items. Caller must provision P/M for the chosen mapping.
Rotary is full-D split-half. Shared map requires past>=S for active requests.
error chooses explicit expected rejection tests; malformed or unsupported ordinary custom cases fail.
write_conflict requires at least two q>0 requests; picks stable pair, lowers larger past and aliases append-start page. B2 with two active requests is supported.

cum_start/cum_end/cum_order/negative_past/decode_length/post_overflow/table_small/bad_page/position/write_conflict/workspace/workspace_alignment/alias/pool_alias/tensor_alignment/null_rotary require T>0.

decode_length requires T>=2 and supported decode head geometry. table_small requires M*S<2147483647. position requires at least one active post>1. position/null_rotary normalize full-D split-half RoPE.
d256_window is prefill-only. Host descriptor rejection cases may use T=0; ordinary all-empty cases remain valid.
checks: batch > 0 and num_heads > 0 and kv_num_heads > 0 and num_heads % kv_num_heads == 0
num_pages > 0 and page_size > 0 and table_columns > 0 and max_position > 0
shared_prefix >= 0 and (shared_prefix == 0 or mapping == 'shared' and shared_prefix % page_size == 0)

diagnostic_flags.description: 0|1, requires COMPARE=1 and FLASH_SOURCE build. Same logical FP16 data compares complete Page/dense, original bare Flash and common post-RoPE cores with shared timer. Diagnostic Page fallback is explicitly default; normal MODE still uses online fallback.
0: Page complete first (default); 1: dense complete first. Alternate across same-host pairs; same data/config/copies and confirm preset.
0|1; list actual coverage/custom keys without GPU allocation or launches. All tiers retain supported RoPE x window combinations.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_AUTOTUNE_MODE
env.description: lookup reads a compatible Page table; online explicitly uses production preparePagedAttention/GQA tuning before final complete-call validation/timing.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_CFG
env.description: Optional default, id=N, legacy splits=N;bkv=N or six-field splits/bkv/hb/qw/mt/nd pin. V2 decode splits=0 is adaptive. Actual fixed:pin geometry logged; forbidden with ranking.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_RANK
env.description: Four-column leaf,shape,priority,config CSV; requires RANK=1 and default per shape. Exact native case key preserves ragged arrays/page/RoPE/options.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_RANK_CATALOG
env.description: 1 emits production Page candidate catalog without GPU work; requires HIPDNN_UT_RANK and RANK=1.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_RANK_REFERENCE
env.description: 1 uses independent sequential confirm in existing shared rank engine.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_PUBLIC
env.description: 1 validates and times the actual public/default entry; config readback stays outside timing; conflicts with production preparation.

env.name: HIPDNN_PAGED_ATTENTION_PRODUCTION_PREPARE
env.description: 1 in comparison calls the real production lookup/online preparation before configured timing; conflicts with public/pinned route.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_FLASH_CFG
env.description: Six-field original Flash configured geometry for marked same-geometry diagnostic comparison.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_FLASH_NATIVE_CFG
env.description: Original Flash native pin: wmma plus splits/bkv/hb/qw/mt/nd; optional pipe-separated active-request list. Must match original legal candidates; conflicts with old diagnostic pin.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_COMPARE_RANK
env.description: page|flash ranks that complete comparison entry through the shared native engine, with CPU/storage checks and finite production candidates; Page requires RANK=1. Conflicts with public/preparation/config pins.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_COMPARE_COMPLETE_ONLY
env.description: 1 skips bare/core timing in COMPARE=1 while retaining both complete timings and precision/storage checks. Unmeasured diagnostics are null.

env.name: HIPDNN_UT_DENSE_CAPACITY
env.description: Comparison-only positive dense storage capacity, applied symmetrically to old/new controls for capacity sentinels; no production dispatch change.
